topic: feelings (happy, sad, sleepy, surprised) and being kind
title: Feelings Friends
yt_description:
Learn to recognize and express different feelings like happy, sad, sleepy, and surprised with our friends. This song teaches kindness and empathy towards others. Help your child develop social skills and emotional intelligence.

🎵 Feelings Friends

Hello friends
Let's play
Feelings today

I'm happy
I'm sad
I'm sleepy too

We're feelings friends
Kind to each other
Every single day

I'm surprised
I'm happy too
We care about you

We're feelings friends
Kind to each other
Every single day
Bye friends

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
